welcome.en: Welcome to FMRC. How can we help you today? Choose a topic below or send our team a message.
welcome.fil: Kumusta! Paano kami makatutulong? Pumili ng paksa sa ibaba o magpadala ng mensahe sa aming team.

offline.en: The team is away right now. Leave a message and check back for a reply.
offline.fil: Wala pang available na team member. Mag-iwan ng mensahe at balikan ang sagot.

fallback.en: I couldn’t find a clear answer. Try a topic below or message the FMRC team.
fallback.fil: Wala akong nakitang malinaw na sagot. Subukan ang paksa sa ibaba o i-message ang FMRC team.

en.question: How do I order a product?
en.answer: Choose a product and submit an order request. FMRC reviews the request before payment becomes available.
steps: Open Products and choose an item. Review its details, price and available stock.
Sign in, then use Buy Now or add the item to your cart. Check the item and quantity.
At checkout, choose an available pickup or delivery option and complete the required details.
Review the total, delivery fee and published transaction terms and refund policy. Submit your order request once.
Open My Orders to follow FMRC’s review. An approved request makes the permitted payment action available.
Pay using the method offered for that order. Online payments are confirmed by the payment provider.
Follow the preparation and pickup or delivery updates in My Orders. Confirm receipt when the option is available.

fil.question: Paano ako oorder ng produkto?
fil.answer: Pumili ng produkto at magsumite ng order request. Susuriin muna ito ng FMRC bago maging available ang pagbabayad.
steps: Buksan ang Products at pumili ng item. Basahin ang detalye, presyo at available na stock.
Mag-sign in, pagkatapos ay piliin ang Buy Now o idagdag ang item sa cart. Suriin ang item at dami.
Sa checkout, pumili ng available na pickup o delivery at kumpletuhin ang mga detalye.
Suriin ang kabuuang bayad, delivery fee, Transaction Terms at Refund Policy. Isumite nang isang beses ang order request.
Buksan ang My Orders para sa resulta ng pagsusuri ng FMRC. Kapag aprubado, lalabas ang angkop na paraan ng pagbabayad.
Magbayad gamit ang paraang available sa order. Ang payment provider ang nagkukumpirma ng online payment.
Subaybayan sa My Orders ang paghahanda at pickup o delivery. Kumpirmahin ang pagtanggap kapag available na ang opsyon.

en.question: What are the two appointment processes?
en.answer: There are two business processes: a service consultation and a custom-product request. Online and face-to-face are meeting methods within those processes.
steps: For advice or a service discussion, book a service consultation. Completing it does not automatically create an order.
For a product made to your requirements, choose Request a custom product. FMRC confirms the consultation outcome before preparing a quotation.
Choose Online or Face-to-face at FMRC when booking either applicable appointment.

fil.question: Ano ang dalawang proseso ng appointment?
fil.answer: May dalawang proseso: service consultation at custom-product request. Ang Online at Face-to-face ay paraan ng pagpupulong sa loob ng mga prosesong ito.
steps: Para sa payo o pagtalakay ng serbisyo, pumili ng service consultation. Hindi ito awtomatikong lumilikha ng order.
Para sa produktong ayon sa iyong pangangailangan, piliin ang Request a custom product. Kukumpirmahin muna ng FMRC ang resulta ng konsultasyon bago maghanda ng quotation.
Pumili ng Online o Face-to-face at FMRC kapag nagbu-book ng angkop na appointment.

en.question: How do I book a consultation?
en.answer: Use Set an Appointment and complete the booking steps. Available dates and times come from the FMRC calendar.
steps: Open Set an Appointment. Sign in when the booking flow asks you to.
Complete your personal and contact details.
Choose your Purpose of Visit and the meeting method. Add relevant notes.
Choose an available date and time, then review the complete appointment details.
Submit once and keep the confirmation. Use My Appointments for the current schedule and available actions.

fil.question: Paano mag-book ng konsultasyon?
fil.answer: Gamitin ang Set an Appointment at kumpletuhin ang mga hakbang. Ang available na petsa at oras ay mula sa kalendaryo ng FMRC.
steps: Buksan ang Set an Appointment. Mag-sign in kapag hiningi ng booking flow.
Kumpletuhin ang personal at contact details.
Piliin ang Purpose of Visit at paraan ng pagpupulong. Magdagdag ng mahahalagang tala.
Pumili ng available na petsa at oras, at suriin ang lahat ng detalye.
Isumite nang isang beses at itago ang kumpirmasyon. Buksan ang My Appointments para sa kasalukuyang iskedyul at mga available na aksyon.

aliases: how do I schedule an appointment

en.question: How do I request a custom product?
en.answer: A custom product starts with an appointment and an attended consultation. A meeting link alone does not advance a request to quotation.
steps: In Set an Appointment, choose Request a custom product and the relevant FMRC service.
Describe the product, quantity and requirements. Supply permitted design files through the booking or appointment tools when needed.
Choose an available consultation schedule, review the information and submit.
Attend the consultation. FMRC records the outcome and confirms specifications before issuing an eligible quotation.
Review the quotation and agreements. Acceptance creates one linked order. Complete the offered full payment before production proceeds.
Follow production and pickup or delivery through the linked order. Ask FMRC before changing accepted specifications.

fil.question: Paano humiling ng custom na produkto?
fil.answer: Nagsisimula ang custom na produkto sa appointment at konsultasyong nadaluhan. Hindi sapat ang meeting link lamang para umabot sa quotation.
steps: Sa Set an Appointment, piliin ang Request a custom product at ang angkop na serbisyo ng FMRC.
Ilarawan ang produkto, dami at mga kinakailangan. Kung kailangan, isumite ang pinapayagang design files sa booking o appointment tools.
Pumili ng available na iskedyul, suriin ang impormasyon at isumite.
Dumalo sa konsultasyon. Itatala ng FMRC ang resulta at kukumpirmahin ang mga detalye bago magbigay ng angkop na quotation.
Suriin ang quotation at kasunduan. Ang pagtanggap nito ay lumilikha ng isang linked order. Kumpletuhin ang iniaalok na buong bayad bago ang produksyon.
Subaybayan ang produksyon at pickup o delivery sa linked order. Makipag-ugnayan muna sa FMRC bago baguhin ang napagkasunduang detalye.

en.question: Where is my online meeting link?
en.answer: FMRC supplies the meeting platform and secure meeting link for an online appointment.
steps: Open My Appointments and select the appointment.
Check its current meeting details. Meeting link pending means the team has not supplied a link yet.
Use the link at the confirmed schedule. If it is still missing or does not work, message the FMRC team with your appointment reference.

fil.question: Nasaan ang link ng aking online meeting?
fil.answer: Ang FMRC ang nagbibigay ng meeting platform at secure na link para sa online appointment.
steps: Buksan ang My Appointments at piliin ang appointment.
Tingnan ang meeting details. Ang Meeting link pending ay nangangahulugang wala pang ibinigay na link ang team.
Gamitin ang link sa nakumpirmang iskedyul. Kung wala pa o hindi gumagana, i-message ang FMRC kasama ang appointment reference.

en.question: How do I reschedule an appointment?
en.answer: Available rescheduling actions depend on the appointment’s current status and original start time.
steps: Open My Appointments and select the appointment.
If Reschedule is available, choose a new available date and time and review the details.
Confirm the change and check the updated schedule. If the option is unavailable, contact FMRC rather than making a duplicate booking.

fil.question: Paano magpalit ng iskedyul ng appointment?
fil.answer: Nakabatay sa kasalukuyang status at orihinal na oras ng simula ang mga available na opsyon sa rescheduling.
steps: Buksan ang My Appointments at piliin ang appointment.
Kung available ang Reschedule, pumili ng bagong available na petsa at oras at suriin ang detalye.
Kumpirmahin ang pagbabago at tingnan ang bagong iskedyul. Kung wala ang opsyon, makipag-ugnayan sa FMRC sa halip na gumawa ng dobleng booking.

en.question: Why can’t I pay for my order yet?
en.answer: For a normal product order, FMRC must review and approve the request before payment is available. Approval and starting preparation are separate actions.
steps: Open the order in My Orders and read its current status.
Wait for FMRC’s review or follow any request for information.
After approval, use only the payment action offered on that order. If an approved order still has no available payment action, message FMRC with the order reference.

fil.question: Bakit hindi pa ako makapagbayad sa order?
fil.answer: Para sa karaniwang product order, kailangan munang suriin at aprubahan ng FMRC ang request bago maging available ang pagbabayad. Magkaiba ang approval at pagsisimula ng paghahanda.
steps: Buksan ang order sa My Orders at basahin ang status.
Hintayin ang pagsusuri ng FMRC o sagutin ang hinihinging impormasyon.
Kapag aprubado, gamitin lamang ang payment action na nasa order. Kung wala pa ring opsyon sa aprubadong order, i-message ang FMRC kasama ang order reference.

aliases: when do I pay for my order

en.question: How do I pay online with GCash or a bank app?
en.answer: Use the secure online payment action provided for your approved order. The available method and instructions appear there.
steps: Open My Orders, select the approved order and choose its available online payment action.
For QR Ph, follow the provider’s QR instructions using a supported bank or e-wallet app. Check the amount and recipient details before confirming.
Complete the payment in your app, then return to FMRC and refresh the order if needed.
Wait for confirmed payment status. A redirect, screenshot or typed reference alone does not confirm payment. Do not repeatedly pay a pending transaction; contact FMRC if you need help.

fil.question: Paano magbayad online gamit ang GCash o bank app?
fil.answer: Gamitin ang secure online payment action sa aprubadong order. Makikita roon ang available na paraan at mga tagubilin.
steps: Buksan ang My Orders, piliin ang aprubadong order at ang available nitong online payment action.
Para sa QR Ph, sundin ang QR instructions ng provider gamit ang suportadong bank o e-wallet app. Suriin ang halaga at recipient details bago kumpirmahin.
Kumpletuhin ang bayad sa iyong app, pagkatapos ay bumalik sa FMRC at i-refresh ang order kung kailangan.

Hintayin ang confirmed payment status. Hindi sapat ang redirect, screenshot o inilagay na reference lamang. Huwag paulit-ulit magbayad sa pending na transaksyon; humingi ng tulong sa FMRC kung kailangan.

en.question: Can I pay cash when I collect my order?
en.answer: Cash on pickup is available for eligible normal pickup orders when FMRC has enabled that method. It is not a delivery cash-on-delivery option.
steps: Choose Pickup at checkout and select Cash on pickup if it is offered.
Wait for the order’s approval and collection instructions in My Orders.
Visit FMRC when instructed and complete the required payment at the counter. Custom-product orders follow their separate quotation and advance-payment requirements.

fil.question: Puwede bang cash kapag kukunin ang order?
fil.answer: Available ang Cash on pickup para sa angkop na karaniwang pickup orders kapag naka-enable ito sa FMRC. Hindi ito cash-on-delivery para sa delivery orders.
steps: Piliin ang Pickup sa checkout at Cash on pickup kung iniaalok ito.
Hintayin sa My Orders ang approval at mga tagubilin sa pagkuha.
Pumunta sa FMRC ayon sa tagubilin at kumpletuhin ang bayad sa counter. May hiwalay na quotation at advance-payment requirements ang custom-product orders.

en.question: How do I check my order status?
en.answer: My Orders shows the current review, payment, preparation and fulfillment information for your account.
steps: Sign in and open My Orders from your profile menu.
Select the order and review its current status and available actions.
For delivery, check the recorded courier and tracking details when available.
If an update is unclear, message FMRC with the order reference. This help assistant cannot look up or change your private order status.

fil.question: Paano tingnan ang status ng order ko?
fil.answer: Makikita sa My Orders ang kasalukuyang review, payment, preparation at fulfillment information ng iyong account.
steps: Mag-sign in at buksan ang My Orders sa profile menu.
Piliin ang order at suriin ang status at available na mga aksyon.
Para sa delivery, tingnan ang courier at tracking details kapag available na.
Kung hindi malinaw ang update, i-message ang FMRC kasama ang order reference. Hindi kayang tingnan o baguhin ng help assistant ang pribadong status ng order mo.

en.question: Where can FMRC deliver and how much does it cost?
en.answer: Delivery availability and fees depend on your selected address and the current published delivery settings.
steps: At checkout, enter the correct province, city or municipality and postal code.
Choose an available delivery option and review the quoted fee, preparation time and delivery estimate.
Review the total before submitting. If the address is not supported, use an offered alternative or ask FMRC for guidance.

fil.question: Saan puwedeng mag-deliver at magkano ang bayad?
fil.answer: Nakabatay sa napiling address at kasalukuyang published delivery settings ang availability at bayad sa delivery.
steps: Sa checkout, ilagay nang tama ang probinsya, lungsod o munisipalidad at postal code.
Pumili ng available na delivery option at suriin ang quoted fee, preparation time at delivery estimate.
Suriin ang kabuuang bayad bago isumite. Kung hindi supported ang address, gumamit ng iniaalok na alternatibo o magtanong sa FMRC.

en.question: How do I request a return or refund?
en.answer: Use the available Return / Refund action in My Orders and refer to the published Refund Policy. FMRC reviews requests and available remedies.
steps: Open My Orders and select the affected order.
Choose Return / Refund if the action is available. Identify the item, explain the concern and provide the evidence requested by that form.
Submit once and follow the review and any return instructions.
Check the current request status. Refund approval and payment-provider processing are separate stages. If the online option is unavailable, contact FMRC promptly.

fil.question: Paano humiling ng return o refund?
fil.answer: Gamitin ang available na Return / Refund sa My Orders at basahin ang published Refund Policy. Sinusuri ng FMRC ang request at mga angkop na solusyon.
steps: Buksan ang My Orders at piliin ang kaugnay na order.
Piliin ang Return / Refund kung available. Tukuyin ang item, ipaliwanag ang problema at ibigay ang ebidensyang hinihingi ng form.
Isumite nang isang beses at sundin ang pagsusuri at mga tagubilin sa pagbabalik.
Tingnan ang kasalukuyang status. Magkaiba ang refund approval at pagproseso ng payment provider. Kung wala ang online na opsyon, agad makipag-ugnayan sa FMRC.

aliases: how can I refund an order
can I return a defective item

en.question: How do I cancel an order?
en.answer: Cancellation actions depend on the order’s current stage. Paid orders and refunds follow the published policy and applicable review.
steps: Open the order in My Orders.
Use the available cancellation action, read the instructions and provide the required reason.
Check the result or review status. If cancellation is unavailable, message FMRC with the reference instead of placing another order.

fil.question: Paano magkansela ng order?
fil.answer: Nakabatay sa kasalukuyang yugto ng order ang cancellation actions. Ang paid orders at refunds ay sumusunod sa published policy at angkop na pagsusuri.
steps: Buksan ang order sa My Orders.
Gamitin ang available na cancellation action, basahin ang mga tagubilin at ibigay ang dahilan.
Tingnan ang resulta o review status. Kung wala ang cancellation, i-message ang FMRC kasama ang reference sa halip na gumawa ng panibagong order.

en.question: How do I accept a custom-product quotation?
en.answer: Review the quotation and final specifications after FMRC has confirmed your consultation outcome.
steps: Open the custom-product request from My Appointments and read the offered quotation and agreements.
If the specifications and amount are correct, use the available acceptance action before the quotation expires.
Open the linked order and complete the offered full payment before production.
For changes to an accepted or paid agreement, ask FMRC about the close-and-requote process. Do not assume the old payment or specifications can simply be edited.

fil.question: Paano tanggapin ang quotation ng custom na produkto?
fil.answer: Suriin ang quotation at final specifications matapos kumpirmahin ng FMRC ang resulta ng konsultasyon.
steps: Buksan ang custom-product request sa My Appointments at basahin ang quotation at kasunduan.
Kung tama ang mga detalye at halaga, gamitin ang available na acceptance action bago mag-expire ang quotation.
Buksan ang linked order at kumpletuhin ang iniaalok na buong bayad bago ang produksyon.
Para sa pagbabago sa tinanggap o bayad nang kasunduan, itanong sa FMRC ang close-and-requote process. Huwag ipagpalagay na basta mae-edit ang dating bayad o detalye.

en.question: How do I sign in or reset my password?
en.answer: Use the Customer sign-in page. Never send your password, one-time code or bank credentials in support messages.
steps: Choose Sign In and use your registered account details or an offered Google sign-in option.
If you forgot your password, select Forgot password and follow the email verification steps.
If you still cannot access your account, contact FMRC through the official contact channels. Do not share your one-time code with the team.

fil.question: Paano mag-sign in o mag-reset ng password?
fil.answer: Gamitin ang Customer sign-in page. Huwag ipadala sa support ang password, one-time code o bank credentials.
steps: Piliin ang Sign In at gamitin ang rehistradong account details o ang available na Google sign-in.
Kung nakalimutan ang password, piliin ang Forgot password at sundin ang email verification steps.
Kung hindi pa rin makapasok, gamitin ang official contact channels ng FMRC. Huwag ibahagi sa team ang one-time code.

en.question: How can I contact the FMRC team?
en.answer: Choose Message FMRC here or use Send Us a Message on the Contact page. Both open the same support inbox.
steps: Sign in to send a private message and keep your conversation history.
Describe your concern and include the relevant order or appointment reference if you have one.
If the team is available, an operator can reply while you are connected. Otherwise leave your message and check back for a reply.
For the published phone number, Facebook page and other official contact details, open Contact.

fil.question: Paano makipag-ugnayan sa FMRC team?
fil.answer: Piliin ang Message FMRC rito o ang Send Us a Message sa Contact page. Iisa ang support inbox na binubuksan ng mga ito.
steps: Mag-sign in upang makapagpadala ng pribadong mensahe at magkaroon ng conversation history.
Ilarawan ang tanong o problema at isama ang order o appointment reference kung mayroon.
Kung available ang team, maaaring sumagot ang operator habang konektado kayo. Kung wala, iwan ang mensahe at balikan ang sagot.
Para sa published na numero, Facebook page at iba pang official contact details, buksan ang Contact.
